question: Indian musician Ravi Shankar won his first Grammy Award in 1968 for best chamber music performance for which of the following works done by him?
solution:
The correct answer is __**West Meets East.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian musician **Ravi Shankar **won his **first Grammy Award in 1968** for best chamber music performance for the work** "West Meets East".**
 
• "West Meets East" is a collaboration between **Ravi Shankar** and **Yehudi Menuhin,** a renowned violinist.
 
• The album features a fusion of **Indian classical music** and **Western classical music.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In the latter part of the 20th century, Ravi Shankar rose to prominence as the most well-known authority on **North Indian classical music **worldwide.

 
 
• In **1999, **Shankar received the **Bharat Ratna, **the highest civilian distinction in India.
 
 
 
• "**The Concert for Bangladesh"** was a benefit concert organized by **George Harrison and Ravi Shankar** in **1971 **to raise funds for **refugees in East Pakistan (now Bangladesh).**
 
• **"The Sounds of India"** is a **1968** album by Ravi Shankar that features traditional Indian classical music.
 
• **"Full Circle - Carnegie Hall"** is a live album by Ravi Shankar, released in** 2002**, that features a concert recorded at Carnegie Hall in 2000.
